name: SkyHold
description:
Welcome to SkyHold, a skyblock server for Minecraft Bedrock Edition. Start on a block of grass over the void and grow it into an island of your own.

🏝 Your island, your way

• An endless ore generator: mine it for cobblestone and every ore, and earn points as you go

• Name your island, write a welcome for visitors, choose its sky and weather, and decide what visitors may do

• Invite friends to build with you, and upgrade for more members and spawners

• Likes from visitors put the best islands at the top of the list

💰 A real economy

• Shopkeepers at the castle market buy and sell everything a skyblock needs

• Sell your haul from anywhere with /sell

• The Enchanter and the Blacksmith enchant and mend your gear

• Safe two-way trading with other players

🎁 Something every day

• A free crate every day, and rewards for logging in day after day

• Vote keys for the rare crate, the only place spawners come from

• 60 challenges across five ranks, plus new daily and weekly challenges

• 21 achievements to earn

🏆 Compete

• Leaderboards for points, money and the parkour course

• Race the sky course against the clock

✨ More

• Eight pets to adopt, from a Will-o'-Wisp to a Sky Whale

• Particle trails and chat colours

• Friends, parties and party chat

• A grand spawn with a giant World Tree, a castle market and an airship

🛡 Fair and safe for everyone

• Nothing is sold for real money. Every perk is earned in game.

• Chat is checked before it is sent, so personal details and contact requests stay out

• Anyone can report a player, or call for help with /sos
